Ancient Enemies: Re-rolls natural 1s on To Wound rolls when striking models with the keyword in brackets (e.g. Ancient Enemies (Elf) works against Elves).
Arcing Shot: Siege Engine fire that lobs over obstacles: no Line of Sight needed if a friendly model can see the target, and no In The Way rolls except for things clearly overhanging the final target.
Backstabbers: Gets +1 to wound when striking an enemy that is Trapped.
Bane of Kings: Must re-roll every failed To Wound roll, for both Shooting Attacks and Strikes.
Blades of the Dead: Strikes ignore armour: the target uses 10 minus its Courage value as its Defence (Courage 4+ means Defence 6) when this model rolls to wound.
Bodyguard: Each such model is assigned a Hero to protect (the General if same Faction, otherwise the highest-tier Hero of its Faction). While that Hero lives, it passes all Courage tests automatically.
Burly: No -1 Duel penalty for two-handed weapons, and can move at full speed while carrying a Heavy Object.
Cave Dweller: +1 to Jump, Leap and Climb tests. Sees normally in the dark, and shots against it at night don't get the +1 to wound bonus.
Chariot Charge: Chariot movement: turn up to 45°, then drive straight ahead, turning again every 4", inflicting its listed Impact Hits on anything it runs into. Counts as charging whoever stops it.
Direct Shot: Siege Engine fire in a flat line: needs Line of Sight (measured from the firing point) to the target and to any model the shot scatters onto, and makes normal In The Way rolls.
Dominant: Counts as the number of models in brackets when counting models near an objective, in a board area, or escaping the board. With two sources, use the higher value.
Expert Rider: When mounted: re-roll Jump, Swim and Thrown Rider tests, pick up Light Objects without dismounting, and keep the shield's +1 Defence even when also carrying a bow.
Expert Shot: Makes two Shooting Attacks per Shoot phase instead of one, resolved one at a time with the same missile weapon; they may target different enemies.
Fearful: Must pass a Courage test at the start of its move to Charge; if it fails it can't move that turn but otherwise acts normally.
Fell Sight: Can Charge without Line of Sight, and can Charge or target models with Stalk Unseen with no penalty. A rider benefits if their Mount has it.
Fly: Moves (usually 12") over models and terrain, ignoring enemy Control Zones; must land to act mid-move and can't end in woods or on unreachable/unsafe spots. If it chooses not to fly, it moves 4".
Foresight of the Eldar: Before deployment roll a D6 to get Foresight points. While alive, spend them to add +1 each to your Priority roll (max 6).
General Hunter: Regains one spent Might point immediately if it kills the enemy General in a Combat.
Hadhafang: Elven hand-and-a-half weapon that grants +1 to wound when striking Spirit models.
Harbinger of Evil: Enemy models within the range in brackets get -1 on Courage tests (doesn't stack with similar effects). Models with this rule ignore enemy Harbinger of Evil.
Hatred: Gets +1 to wound when striking models with the keyword in brackets (e.g. Hatred (Man) works against Men).
Horse Lord: Whenever its Mount takes a Wound, roll a D6: on a 6 it is ignored. The rider can also spend their own Fate to save wounds on the Mount.
Large Target: When shooting at this model, only Monsters, Siege Engines and War Beasts count as In The Way. Shooting into a Combat it is in still needs the usual In The Way roll.
Leader: May include Warrior models of the type named in brackets in its Warband.
Lord of the West: May re-roll one D6 in each Duel roll, and one D6 when rolling To Wound for its Strikes.
Master of Battle: When an enemy Hero within 6" declares a Heroic Action, roll a D6; on the bracketed number or more, this model may declare the same Heroic Action for free, even with no Might left.
Mighty Blow: Each successful Strike that isn't prevented inflicts 2 Wounds instead of 1.
Mighty Hero: Gets one free Might point at the start of every turn, even above its normal maximum; it is lost if not used that turn.
Monstrous Charge: +1 Attack when it Charges. If it charged and wins the Duel, enemies in the fight with lower Strength are knocked Prone before it strikes (cavalry count as Knocked Flying).
Mountain Dweller: Moves through rocky Difficult Terrain as open ground and may re-roll Jump, Leap and Climb tests. On cavalry, rider and mount are checked separately.
Poisoned Attacks: Must re-roll natural 1s on To Wound rolls for Strikes and Shooting Attacks. If tied to a specific weapon, only that weapon gets the re-roll.
Resistant to Magic: Whenever targeted by a Magical Power, rolls one extra free die to Resist, even with no Will left or none spent. Stacks with similar effects.
Sharpshooter: When shooting at cavalry, may choose rider or Mount as the target, and a hit always strikes the chosen part with no In The Way roll.
Shieldwall: With a shield and in base contact with two or more friends who also have Shieldwall and shields, gets +1 Defence (applied before Backing Away). Not for Prone or Cavalry models.
Spectral Walk: Never slowed by Difficult Terrain, and always counts as rolling a 6 on Climb, Jump, Leap and Swim tests.
Stalk Unseen: Infantry that is partly hidden by terrain can't be seen from more than 6" away unless the enemy has a fully clear view, so it can't be shot, targeted by magic or similar.
Static: This Siege Engine can never be moved or rotated.
Survival Instinct: Every time it suffers an unprevented Wound it must take a Courage test; on a failure it flees and is removed as a casualty.
Swift Movement: Not slowed by Difficult Terrain (except water) and crosses obstacles without Jump or Climb tests, though vertical distance still counts toward its move. Must end its move level.
Sworn Protector: While the specific model named in brackets is alive and on the board, this model automatically passes all Courage tests.
Terror: An enemy must pass a Courage test at the start of its move to Charge this model; on a failure it can't move that turn. Terror (X) only affects models with keyword X.
Throw Stones: If it didn't move in the Move phase, it may make a Shooting Attack that turn; the bracket gives the range and Strength of the throw.
Trample: War Beast movement: pivot to face any direction, then move its full Move straight ahead ignoring Control Zones, dealing its listed Impact Hits to each model it hits. Can't trample if charged by greater total Strength.
Unyielding Combat Stance: Whenever it would be knocked Prone, roll a D6: on a 4+ it stays standing. If mounted and it succeeds, it is still thrown but counts as rolling a 6 on the Thrown Rider chart.
Venom: Re-rolls all failed To Wound rolls for Strikes. After each Combat, pick one enemy it wounded but didn't kill and roll a D6: on a 6 that model takes another Wound.
Vilya: Elven Ring: the bearer may re-roll failed Fate rolls.
Will of Evil: Loses 1 Will in the End phase if it fought that turn; at 0 Will it is banished. Can't spend its last Will point on spells or abilities. Ignores the Invisible rule.
Woodland Creature: Moves through wooded Difficult Terrain as open ground. On cavalry, rider and mount are checked separately; a mount with it still gets charge bonuses.
